subject.title: fix(agents): agent-created files get lowercased names on Windows

question: Should the case-preserving Windows normalization contract remain as the local `src/infra/path-guards.ts` helper, or should the dependency expose an explicit preserving-case API before this sandbox-adjacent change lands?
rationale: The behavior change is narrow and evidence-backed, but choosing where the normalization contract lives determines how reliably the workspace-boundary invariant stays aligned with `@openclaw/fs-safe` over future updates.

options.title: Accept the local helper
options.body: Keep the helper local, with its focused equivalence and containment tests as the explicit contract for this returned-path use case.

options.title: Upstream an explicit API
options.body: Add a preserving-case normalization export to the dependency, then consume that API so comparison and returned-path normalization share one owner.

recommendation.title: Accept the local helper
recommendation.body: Keep the helper local, with its focused equivalence and containment tests as the explicit contract for this returned-path use case.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and supplied the end-to-end validation that exercises the exact agent-write boundary affected by this choice.
